title: Audit every decision rule and review metric that grades on mean net R alone (exit-lever gate RULE-M20-EXIT-LEVER-IS-OOS-GATE, promotion rules, perf-review headline, LTR hold-vs-option, desk lifecycle) and propose the risk-adjusted form under the operator's 2026-10-29 objective (net P&L first, risk second; a big risk cut for a small R cost wins)
note: Widened per SYSTEM-CONFORMANCE-AUDIT (#21197): the audit also covers the Stage-0 promotion rule, the Stage-2 demotion test (Tier 3), the desk_grade gate and the prop gate (RULE-P5-GATE-BRK-PER-LEG-V2): each graded against the operator objective (absolute net P&L $/% per account and book; risk reduction the tie-breaker).
